description: A newline before a namespaced call's :: ends an object element early
notes: The spec's function call grammar has a single identifier as the function name (FunctionCall = Identifier "(" arguments ")"), and :: is not one of its tokens. hashicorp/hcl accepts names separated by :: and reports them joined with :: as the function name (finishParsingFunctionCall in hclsyntax/parser.go). The grammar lists Newline as a separator between object elements, but the prose says newlines between the braces are ignored as whitespace, and prose has priority over the grammar, so the newline is ignored and the input is valid. hashicorp/hcl makes newlines significant inside object constructors and ends the element at the newline (parseObjectCons in hclsyntax/parser.go calls PushIncludeNewlines(true)), and the next line, which starts with ::, can't start another element.
reference_error: Expected the start of an expression, but found an invalid expression token
